## Scope

Related #2720 (N19). Explain silent stalls without turning `emit_events` grants into obligations, re-prompts, retries or parking. Re-drive remains an operator action through `swarm event replay`.

- One derived operational-status owner joins detached instance, delivery, completion, publication and frozen tool-output evidence in the existing coherent store snapshot. API/CLI status leads with the operational state and exact agent/event/delivery attribution; text retains the frozen emit evidence too. Missing evidence is explicitly unknown, not fabricated silence. Remove the duplicate projection and scoring-domain special case.
- Apply the [USER's fixed run-level alert ruling](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2720#issuecomment-6242655302): delete per-flow policy selection, use 300 seconds, emit a run envelope containing the stalled-instance list, and deduplicate by run/progress/attribution set. No new verify refusal. Active/waiting siblings remain visible without inventing a run-level escalation.
- Preserve the immutable completion/publication/delivery owners, source scope, cancellation outcomes and zero-added-execution semantics. No new journal, mutable incident system, launch capability, automatic replay or test-timeout/budget increase.

[Implementation gate](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2720#issuecomment-6221291258) · [Accepted RED-to-GREEN at 859247475a](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2720#issuecomment-6245827935) · [Exact fan-out successor authorization](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2720#issuecomment-6247003514)

The 20 accepted patches rebase without conflicts and compare `=`. Three subsequent repairs are limited to gofmt, the exact startup-census fingerprint and the authorized fan-out successor/comparator. Current size: 71 files, +3729/-580, net +3149.

- **Current head:** nine affected roots / 81 terminal records PASS, zero failures/skips. Complete native run-setup history/hostility, behavioral-assertion preservation, exact fan-out current endpoint and negative controls, unchanged #2617 endpoint history, served-quiescence recipes, and all three affected native consumers on SQLite and PostgreSQL. Receipt `test-results/2720-wave2/approved-successor-controls.jsonl`, SHA256 `ab7007f5ca6b70c2859f48403f26cff59a0e0502db4b12558dbb012f86e8006c`.
- The append-only comparator preserves all 893 recipe identities and immutable Before/After values. Only the exact N19 MixedDisposition function gains Successor; its two observation blocks reverse at their approved locations to immutable After. The installed live endpoint must match Successor. Existing 16 functions / 27 propagation calls and #2617's closed endpoint list are unchanged; no generic exception or assertion deletion. Adds zero roots.
- **Lean-rebase evidence, attributed to its actual head:** 45 focused roots / 289 terminal records PASS at `86d8358d18`, including native both-store attribution/publication/coherent snapshot/waits, API/CLI projection and describe contracts, and monitor/adapter controls. Seven formatting-affected roots pass at `4aeba56148`; four startup-census/refusal roots pass without update mode at `cc17bef5e7`.
- LIGHT census component `cc17bef5e7` refreshes only `buildRuntimeComposition` for the settled policy-resolver deletion: 650 identities, zero added/deleted; audit rows/proof families unchanged. Its exact owner/caller/execution correspondence is committed. The overall PR and the comparator repair are FULL track.
- Earlier local native-package timeout remains incomplete evidence, not an infrastructure diagnosis or passing receipt. Adopted T3 applies at the eventual hosted head. Earlier accepted race/concurrency and quiet CLI/restart evidence retains its original source attribution; no duplicate local tier or server2 campaign.

**Preflight: pass (633.983s)** at this exact signed head, Go 1.26.8; all 25 phases complete, zero failed/unstarted. Receipt `test-results/preflight/20261018T072054.393634949-a3cf13e2-2e55-4f14-a5e1-82be6269517d/receipt.json`, SHA256 `252e0bd2e479fa6d1d8060ef022a9290a3e69729f40c81202660f3f4274d39fd`; canonical `preflight/local` success **56622043890**, attempt `a3cf13e2-2e55-4f14-a5e1-82be6269517d`. Earlier format/census/codemod preflight failures are retained and classified, not overwritten or credited as green. The preflight soft target is not raised.

Local-Tier: focused

Monitor/adapter, API/CLI, native store/manager, provider/continuation and codemod guard reaches are already owned; no additional named-unit line or blanket full tier. No workflow, planner, CI admission, test ceiling, baseline raise or C2 activation change.

Reviewer-e FINAL HEAD verdict is requested for this exact source, including the authorized successor repair. Publication does not claim issue closure or merge permission. A hosted run red only on #2734's attachment-progress/terminal-retirement cancellation signature remains held for the user, with no rerun. Merge requires the exact-head review, qualifying hosted evidence and orchestrator gate/sequencing.
